title: 第六章 学校课程
slug: 民国我包国维黄埔一期
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

分班了，有些巧，和第一名蒋羡耘分到了一个班。从上海考场同一批次到的广州，船上一起大半月的时光多少有着些交集。

同班的还有两位大名鼎鼎的人物，陈亘和胡纵楠。每个人都有自己的特色，性格迥异，胡纵楠，儒雅狂放。而陈亘幽默热情，经常开些小玩笑，妙语连珠，无拘无束。

陈亘运气还好的很，直接被校长关注上了。

面试的时候，校长正好也在考场，注意到了有些瘦削精干的陈亘，青年时期较瘦，往后就更结实精干，中等身材。

说他爷爷力大无比，能站在桌子上用牙齿叼起两桶水来。军人武术世家，练过武，他也行，当即要表演一下，不过被校长制止了，但他的表现，给校长留下了深刻的印象。

包国维来自后世，两世为人，气质不自然会有些不同于当前年代这些人。在其他同学看来，包国维也是一个颇为奇特不一般的人。

要上的课程很多，有战术学、兵器学、筑城学、交通学、地形学等基础学科，以及军制学、军史等专业课程，强调实战应用。

还有术科训练以制式教练、实弹射击、野外演习为主，培养指挥作战能力。

另外还有体能训练，刺杀格斗训练。

另外就是思想教育课程，三民主义、中国近现代史、世界革命史、社会理论等课程。

分科的话，第一期基本都是步兵科。

这一堂课，是钱大军教官在讲兵器学，大炮的使用。

钱教官履历丰富，出身保定军校，后又选送日本士官学校12期，和校长一样选学的炮兵科。

这样的资历，给他们这些大多数尚且没上过战场的同学当教官是完全够格的，现在是军阀混战时期，大炮显得格外重要，谁手里头的大炮多，谁就最有可能取得胜利。

钱教官说了下现在的一些大炮：“沈造75迫击炮，23年仿制，最大射程约2850米，是现在最为重要的大炮。汉造75迫击炮，最大射程约300-500米。......

三一式75毫米野炮，日本有坂速射炮，1904年式山炮，俄制，射程4500米。

克鲁伯1904年式75毫米山炮，射程4250米，为末代碳钢山炮。

多数火炮为仿制或改进自日本、俄国等国的型号，如沈造、汉造、晋造等厂生产的迫击炮。

迫击炮机动性强、射程适中......”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

We were divided into classes, and by some coincidence, we were assigned to the same class as Jiang Xianyun, who ranked first.We arrived in Guangzhou in the same batch from the Shanghai examination center, and the time spent together on the ship for more than half a month had some overlap.

There are also two famous figures in the same class, Chen Gen and Hu Zongnan.Everyone has their own characteristics and different personalities. Hu Zongnan is elegant and wild.Chen Gen is humorous and enthusiastic, often making small jokes and making witty remarks without restraint.

Chen Gen was very lucky and was immediately noticed by the principal.

During the interview, the principal happened to be in the examination room and noticed the somewhat lean and lean Chen Gen. He was thinner in his youth, but later became stronger, leaner, and of medium build.

He said that his grandfather was so strong that he could stand on the table and pick up two buckets of water with his teeth.He comes from a military and martial arts family and has practiced martial arts. He is also good at it. He immediately wanted to perform, but was stopped by the principal, but his performance left a deep impression on the principal.

Bao Guowei came from a later generation and was a man of two generations. His temperament would naturally be somewhat different from those of the current generation.In the eyes of other students, Bao Guowei is also a rather peculiar and unusual person.

There are many courses to take, including basic subjects such as tactics, weapons, fortification, transportation, topography, etc., as well as professional courses such as military system and military history, which emphasize practical application.

There is also technical training focusing on standard coaching, live-fire shooting, and field exercises to cultivate command and combat capabilities.

There is also physical training and assassination and combat training.

In addition, there are ideological education courses, such as the Three People's Principles, modern Chinese history, world revolutionary history, and social theory.

In terms of disciplines, the first phase is basically infantry.

In this class, instructor Qian Dajun was teaching weaponry and the use of cannons.

Instructor Qian has a rich resume. He was born in Baoding Military Academy and was later sent to the Japanese Military Academy for the 12th period. He chose the artillery department like the principal.

With such qualifications, he is fully qualified to serve as instructors for these classmates, most of whom have never been on the battlefield. Now is the period of warlord melee, and artillery is particularly important. Whoever has more cannons is most likely to win.

Instructor Qian talked about some of the current cannons: "The Shen-made 75 mortar was copied in 2023 and has a maximum range of about 2850 meters. It is the most important cannon now. The Han-made 75 mortar has a maximum range of about 300-500 meters. ...

Sanyi 75mm field gun, Japanese Arisaka rapid-fire gun, 1904 mountain gun, made in Russia, with a range of 4,500 meters.

The Krupp 1904 75mm mountain gun, with a range of 4250 meters, is the last carbon steel mountain gun.

Most of the artillery is imitation or improved models from Japan, Russia and other countries, such as mortars produced by Shen, Han, Jin and other factories.

Mortars are highly maneuverable and have moderate range..."
